descriptions.text: Jellyfish Salve (5 applications) If you can’t talk someone into peeing on you after you get stung by a Pain Amplifier Jelly, then this will do the trick. Effect: removes the pain portion of the Kill Me Now It Hurts debuff. Warning: It does not remove the one-minute healing block effect associated with the Jelly’s sting.

beats.headline: A lotion bottle
beats.text: Alone with Donut in the crafting room, Carl opens his two new boxes. The silver boss box for killing Ruckus the chicken hawk holds a case of twenty-five more surefires and a second, more worrying item. It's a lotion bottle, says Donut, who got the same prize, just like the one he used to keep hidden by the bed. Jellyfish Salve, five applications, for the pain of a Pain Amplifier Jelly's sting, though not its one-minute healing block. Carl really hopes they won't have to deal with the water quadrant.

beats.headline: Keep it on the hotlist
beats.text: Over the Akula, Katia sees big blue jellyfish near the entrance. Vadim tells her to watch for the white ones, the pain amplifiers, which are smaller; the big blue ones only wrap round you if you get close. She lands, and Carl puts his hand on her now-silver edge. We're going in, he says. Be safe. Keep that salve I gave you in your hotlist. In and out, she answers.

relations.note: her box held the same prize
